Settings

Connect Google Sheet (no Apps Script needed). Leave a box empty to skip it – the app still works on this phone.

Event

Wrong event, agent or location? Enter the right ones and press Set, or press Reset to clear all (sales stay blocked until an event is added).

Reverse transaction by bill number

Enter a bill number to reverse every transaction on that bill. On the dashboard they are removed; if the bill was already sent to your Google Sheet, matching reversal rows (negative qty and value) are added there.

Reset all data

Erases all sales saved on this phone and sets the dashboard back to zero. Rows already sent to your Google Sheet are not deleted.

Add event

Resets automatically when the date changes.
